$comment: THE ONE PLACE THE PUBLISHING SCOPE AND REGISTRY ARE SET. Change `scope` here, then run `node scripts/set-scope.mjs` to propagate it to every package.json name, every import in docs and source comments, and the workspace README; `node scripts/set-scope.mjs --check` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:scope`) fails if any package name drifts from it. Change `registry` here, then run `node scripts/set-registry.mjs` to propagate it to every package.json's `publishConfig.registry`; `node scripts/set-registry.mjs --check` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:registry`) fails if any package's declared registry drifts from it. Nothing else in this repository should hardcode a scope or a registry.
status: vespeneventures is a dedicated GitHub organization created to own this repository and its packages, and nothing else. Registry is GitHub Packages — the canonical adoption lane, decided in issue #213, not a staging step toward somewhere else. It requires a read:packages token for every install, including for public readers with no other relationship to this org; that is a GitHub Packages platform behavior, and consumers authenticate through whichever plane owns their package credentials. A migration to the public npm registry was planned and cancelled: issues #194 and #196 are closed as not planned, because its first step (claiming the scope on a shared public namespace) was irreversible and no consumer needed what it bought. See docs/DECISIONS.md for the reasoning and docs/PUBLISHING.md section 7 for the recorded decision. Changing this value is a config change here plus separate, irreversible, owner-only setup on the destination registry — do not treat it as a routine edit.
